modern_card.name: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier

effective.basis: TCG release of Duelist Saga (DUSA-EN073), the first printing carrying the errata'd text

changes.historical_text: 1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monstersYou can discard any number of cards to the Graveyard to target the same number of cards on the field; return those targets to the hand.
changes.modern_text: 1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monstersYou can discard any number of cards to the Graveyard, then target the same number of cards your opponent controls; return those cards to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: the discard-to-bounce Ignition effect gained a hard once per turn (modern e1:SetCountLimit(1,id); the historical script sets no count limit, so it can be used repeatedly in a turn) and its targets were narrowed to the opponent's side - modern Duel.SelectTarget(tp,Card.IsAbleToHand,tp,0,LOCATION_ONFIELD,...) against the historical tp,LOCATION_ONFIELD,LOCATION_ONFIELD, which reaches either player's field. The discard remains a cost in both (historical Duel.SendtoGrave(cg,REASON_COST+REASON_DISCARD) inside the cost function).

review.notes: Chain starts at v3 (H5SE-EN001, 2012-03-30), the version the baseline best matches. Earlier transitions v0 (HA01-EN022, 2009-11-05) -> v1 (undated) -> v2 (DT01-EN031, 2010-01-29) -> v3 are PSCT rewordings ('discard any number of cards to return the same number of cards from the field to the hand' -> 'discard ... to target the same number of cards on the field; return those targets to the hand') that formalise targeting without changing resolution; the Edison-era printing is v2 and behaves as the baseline implements. Trailing v4 -> v5 (DUDE-EN008, 2019-10-10) is the Graveyard/GY rewording, cosmetic, not recorded. Minor note: the variant's cdb text ('You can discard any number of cards, then target an equal number of cards on the field; return them to the hand.') is upstream's own paraphrase rather than any printed version (closest v3, ratio 0.8397), though it states the same behaviour as v2/v3. Card data identical to modern (2300/1400, Level 6, WATER, Sea Serpent, Synchro).
